ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this decides the $4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02702. The fee stands and the driver is paid $3.60.

WHY THE FEE STANDS (POL-NS-01, all four limbs). (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:55:03. (b) The GPS trace places him inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (Tampines Mall) - 42 qualifying in-geofence fixes, which answers POL-NS-02. (c) He then held position in one continuous in-geofence run of 409 seconds, 16:55:03 to 17:01:52, against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no longer no_show_threshold_sec is set), and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) The trip was terminated at 17:01:56 under RIDER_NO_SHOW - after the 180-second dwell elapsed at 16:58:03 - with no boarding event recorded.

TO THE RIDER. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. It needs all three limbs. Limb (a) is arguable on your 16:57:23 message 'coming down now' and limb (b) is met by the driver's silence, but limb (c) fails affirmatively: your own device is tracked at 853.9-861.4 m from the pickup pin throughout, with zero fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a large venue. With (c) failed the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01, as your own rider-track claim acknowledged. The chat therefore corroborates the driver: more than two minutes into the wait you were still not at the pickup point. POL-NS-03 does not apply either - the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

TO THE DRIVER. Your payout is 80% of the $4.50 fee = $3.60, fixed by POL-NS-07 and matching the money block (4.50 x 0.8). The anti-farming check on your profile does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the 4-or-more limb, so compensation is paid and the fee stands.

CHECKS THAT DID NOT DISPLACE THE FEE. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is genuine - at 16:55:03 the driver's nearest fix is 0.16 m from the pin and stationary - so the waiting clock runs from the marker and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06: there is no shortfall, 409 seconds exceeding the 180-second minimum, so no refund arises and no advisory-accumulation is needed. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so arrival is established on the exported trace itself. POL-NS-11: the rider's track is not evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not impair his trace.

INTEGRITY AND WEIGHT (POL-GEN-02). The only artifact below weight 1.0 is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02702-01 (MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); it is cited only for its absence and carries no deciding fact, so it does not cap confidence. The artifacts that do carry the deciding facts - EV-GPS-02702, EV-TRIP-02702 and EV-FARE-02702 - all sit at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0; my confidence is 0.90. The ledger reconciles to the policy figure under POL-NS-08(d) (charged 4.50 = platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so no integrity ground to refund arises.

NO ESCALATION, NO REFERRAL. No artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; no integrity limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged; no profile-counter condition for review is met; and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically unless appealed under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed $4.00 (80% of that fee), with $1.00 retained by the platform as its service fee.

Why the fee stands. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out. (a) The trip record carries the platform's own GPS_AUTO 'driver_arrived' event at 07:53:00. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup at that same moment (nearest fix about 0.11 m from the pin, stationary at 0 km/h). (c) The driver held position in a single continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds, from 07:53:00 to 08:02:16, against the free waiting period of 300 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - an excess of 256 seconds, the shortfall being -256.0. (d) The driver terminated at 08:02:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event, 560 seconds after the first in-geofence fix - at or after both the 300 s free period and the 480 s no_show_threshold_sec, and a reason code limb (d) recognises.

The rider's arguments. Your statement that you were 'still inside the interchange' is contradicted by your own device: the rider track in EV-GPS-02703 holds 90 fixes running from 796.46 m to 804.18 m from the pickup pin (mean 800.51 m), none inside the 200 m rider-presence radius. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you: even treating your 07:55:20 message 'coming' as a coordinating message and accepting that the driver did not reply within 120 seconds, limb (c) affirmatively fails on your own fixes - and if it were instead read as undecidable under POL-NS-11, the clause still could not exonerate you, so the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01 on the driver's evidence. POL-NS-06 gives no refund: the dwell exceeds the free period rather than falling short, and there is only one in-geofence run, so no accumulation under limb (i) is needed. POL-NS-03 is not engaged - the driver's stationary fixes lay inside the arrival radius, not outside it and within 400 m, and the trip has a single registered pickup point. Your point that POL-NS-12 is not made out is correct (there is no wait_timer_expired event in the chain), but it changes nothing: the exported trace is COMPLETE at full weight and establishes arrival and dwell on its own, and POL-NS-12 licenses no ruling value.

The driver's points. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute threshold of 4, so the rate limb is never reached; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which is context-only under POL-GEN-01, was not used as a ground. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (no same-pair disputes, no_show_disputes_30d = 1, no artefact conflict), so the case is decided rather than escalated. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (within 10 m, stationary), so no waiting clock is recomputed.

Integrity and weight. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged: no clock skew (arrival event and first in-geofence fix are both 07:53:00), no trace gap (max gap 0 s, 100% coverage, 117 fixes plus a rider track), the chat log holds exactly the 2 messages the trip record counts, and the $5.00 ledger line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02703-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and nothing here rests on it. No claim was discarded at the mechanical check, and none is discarded on the merits.

Money. Cancellation fee in force: $5.00 (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd; EV-FARE-02703 total_charged 5.00). Driver compensation: 80% x $5.00 = $4.00 (EV-FARE-02703 derived driver_compensation 4.00). Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries that same $4.00 - it is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund to the rider, whose $5.00 charge stands. The monetary effect ($4.00) is at or below the $8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

Confidence 0.95, capped by the deciding artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-02703 and EV-TRIP-02703, which agree to the second). No referrals are produced by any clause.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Rider and driver: this ruling decides the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02701. The fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

Arrival and waiting (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02). All four limbs hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:58:47. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02701) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius: the arrival derivation reports a minimum distance of 0.16 m from the pin and 44 qualifying in-geofence fixes, meeting POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test. (c) The driver held position in the geofence for one continuous run of 429 s, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56; the free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so the dwell exceeded it by 249 s, and no longer threshold applies (no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) The driver terminated at 20:06:00 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 253 s after the required dwell elapsed at 20:01:47, with no boarding event.

The rider's exoneration routes fail. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged: at the 19:58:47 marker the driver sat essentially on the pin (0.16 m) and stationary (0.0 kph), so neither the 300 m nor the 15 kph trigger fires. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged: the stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not between the radius and the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-06 (shortfall) is not engaged: 429 s exceeds the 180 s minimum and the derived shortfall is -249 s; the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02701-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, disclosed here), but its absence only makes the accumulation limb (i) unavailable — no accumulation was needed, and POL-NS-06(ii) never reduces the required minimum.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. The rider's 'coming down now' message at 20:01:07 was a coordinating message (limb (a)) and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed any in-app call (limb (b), in_app_calls empty); but limb (c) fails. The rider's own track places the device between 884 m and 891 m from the pin, and 0 of 62 rider fixes fall inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. On this record the zero qualifying count is explained by distance, not by the 25 m accuracy filter, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable; and even on the rider's alternative reading, POL-NS-11 provides that an undecidable limb (c) still cannot exonerate the rider and the fee is decided on the driver's evidence.

No integrity defect under POL-NS-08: the arrived event matches the first qualifying fix to the second (skew 0), the trace has no gaps and 88 fixes, the chat log is complete (2 of 2 messages), and the fare breakdown's 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals the net figure produced from platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50). The deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown, all at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap does not bite; confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the fee in force: 80% of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare breakdown's own money derivation states, the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below 4, so the rate limb is never reached. Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60. No POL-NS-09 trigger is present (the artifacts agree, both counterparty-conflict counters are 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding facts are not impaired), so the case is not escalated, and no clause produces a referral. Profile fields were used only where a clause names them (POL-GEN-01): rating, cancellation rate and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter are context only and carried no weight. The rider's account that he was 'only a few minutes late' is not supported — he was still some 880 m from the pickup when the driver cancelled. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically (POL-GEN-05).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $6.00 cancellation fee stands and no refund is due, because all four conditions POL-NS-01 requires before a no-show fee may be charged are met on this record. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02705 carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 18:18:27. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02705 places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius (POL-NS-02; fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m) from that same second, with 57 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage and no gaps. (c) His continuous in-geofence dwell was 556 seconds, from 18:18:27 to 18:27:43 — 76 seconds more than the 480-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 18:27:44 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. Because the arrival marker here is a driver-pressed BUTTON, it was tested under POL-NS-05 and is not false — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is in the same second, and no admissible fix puts the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at the marker. Your own account, that you were walking to the bay, is not supported by the evidence: your device's fixes in EV-GPS-02705 sit between 789 m and 796 m from the pickup pin for the whole window, every one at 0.0 km/h, with no qualifying fix inside the 200 m rider presence radius. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate you — you sent no locating or coordinating message (the only chat message in EV-CHAT-02705 is the driver's, at 18:18:57) and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, so POL-NS-11's undecidable route is not in play. POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not engaged either (a 76-second surplus, not a shortfall), and POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) bore only on POL-NS-06(i), which neither side needed. To the driver: the fee is upheld and you are paid the compensation POL-NS-07 fixes — 80 percent of the $6.00 fee, which is $4.80 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 57, so neither the count nor the rate limb is met (the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the field that check reads). The fare line reconciles — the $6.00 charged in EV-FARE-02705 matches platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $6.00 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Because a payment to the driver is the outcome, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same $4.80; the rider's charge is not refunded. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, neither profile shows cross-disputes in the trailing 90 days, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below the 3 limb (d) reads), and the anti-farming check is clear. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect, $4.80, does not exceed the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05). The rider's kept claims — which correctly decline to press POL-NS-04, POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-11 — and the driver's kept claims are all accepted and are reflected above. No claim rested on a context-only profile field.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it (80 percent), the platform retaining the residual SGD 0.80. I ran the four POL-NS-01 conditions on the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger. Arrival: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:58:18, and the GPS trace's first in-geofence fix falls at the same second, 0.11 m from the pickup pin and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 46 consecutive qualifying fixes - limbs (a) and (b) hold. Dwell: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus, not a shortfall. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The rider's arguments do not change this. His submission that the driver had not located him, drawn from the driver's 21:58:48 message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), is rejected: limb (d)'s own test is the recorded cancellation reason code, and the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three limb (d) recognises; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not on the record, and the record contradicts it. The rider's own device places him stationary (0.0 km/h in all 72 fixes) between 606 m and 613 m from the pin across the whole window - he was not walking to the bay, and he neither sent a message nor replied to the driver's. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate him (limb (a) fails for want of any rider message; limb (c) fails on his own track), and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present. POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip carries 1 registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the BUTTON marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed. POL-NS-06 gives nothing: the 454 s dwell exceeds the 300 s minimum, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed, and relied on only for its absence) cannot matter, and no interval-summing is required. The rider's POL-NS-10 submissions are correct and afford him nothing (the trip was terminated by the driver, was not scheduled, and the fare ledger's waiting-time line is SGD 0.00). Compensation is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, matching the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips is 0.018, below 0.08. Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The cap is 1.0: the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare ledger, driver profile), and nothing carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew, a 0.0 s maximum trace gap at 100 percent coverage, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case does not escalate. No clause produces a referral: there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii), no mis-selected-code driver-education item under POL-NS-01 because limb (d) is satisfied on the code actually recorded, and no POL-NS-07 escalation packet because the anti-farming check does not trip. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so SGD 3.20 in both fields; the rider's own charge is untouched. Under POL-GEN-05 the monetary effect, SGD 3.20, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. This is an automated, provisional ruling; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

To both parties. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02706 is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is payable. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue.

Why the charge cannot stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if every limb of POL-NS-01 holds, and limb (c) does not. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02706). Measured the way POL-NS-01(c) requires — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap — the driver held position for 67 seconds, from 12:51:17 to 12:52:24 (longest qualifying in-geofence run, EV-GPS-02706), and the platform's own wait timer agrees, running from 12:51:19 to the 12:52:28 termination. That is a shortfall of 113 seconds. Limb (d) fails on the same arithmetic, because the termination did not fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. POL-NS-06 then refunds the cancellation-fee line in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages.

The shortfall cannot be bridged. POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a qualifying traffic advisory covers the pickup road; this trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the only advisory artifact on file, EV-ADVIS-02706-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no accumulation is available and no advisory can be asserted for either party.

The driver's claims. (1) Arrival on admissible fixes: accepted. The trace carries 8 qualifying in-radius fixes on a complete 10-second, 100%-coverage trace, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met — but limb (b) alone does not make the fee chargeable. (2) The 'I'm Here' tap is a genuine marker, not a POL-NS-05 false marker: accepted; the tap coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no false-arrival referral is entered. (3) Limb (d)'s reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three the limb recognises: accepted, but limb (d) also requires termination at or after the elapsed dwell, which fails. (4) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because the driver replied 'ok' within 120 seconds: this is outcome-neutral. Even if the driver is right that his 12:52:32 reply defeats POL-NS-04, the refund flows from POL-NS-06 independently, so the point decides nothing and I do not need to resolve it. (5) No anti-farming concern: accepted, and POL-GEN-01 is respected — the citable trailing-30-day figure is 0 against 107 completed trips, the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not substituted for it, and no other profile field is used to ground any finding about this trip. (6) The 113-second shortfall: accepted, and it is decisive.

The rider's claims. (1) 180 seconds in force, 69 seconds on the platform timer: accepted. (2) 67-second GPS-derived run, 113-second shortfall: accepted. (3) Limb (c) and limb (d) both fail: accepted. (4) No accumulation, advisory missing: accepted. (5) The rider's device sat 13.15 m to 19.08 m from the pin across the whole window: accepted as far as it goes, but it is not needed — POL-NS-06 refunds irrespective of rider presence, so the driver's counterparty statement that the rider 'was not visible' does not change the result. That statement carries no weight_multiplier and forms no part of the confidence cap. The driver's further reason, that he had another booking waiting, is not a ground POL-NS-06 recognises. (6) Relief: accepted — SGD 4.50 is the cancellation-fee line actually charged (EV-FARE-02706, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that is the whole of the contested amount.

Confidence is 0.95. The deciding fact — the shortfall against the 180-second waiting period — is carried by EV-GPS-02706 and EV-TRIP-02706, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, and neither is impaired under POL-NS-08. The missing advisory carries no deciding fact and does not lower the cap.

Referrals: none. No clause produces one. The arrival marker was genuine, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped; and no POL-NS-09 trigger applies (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the parties have no trailing-90-day dispute history, and no deciding artifact is impaired).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02707 is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the charge does not stand. The fee rests on POL-NS-01, which is conjunctive — all four of its limbs must hold. Limbs (a) and (b) do hold: EV-TRIP-02707 records a driver 'arrived' event at 13:31:56, and EV-GPS-02707 places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from that same second, on 15 qualifying in-geofence fixes with 100% coverage and no gaps. The arrival marker is therefore genuine and POL-NS-05 (false arrival) is not engaged, so no false-arrival referral attaches to the driver.

Limb (c) fails, and that is decisive. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-02707.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The driver's own trace measures his continuous in-geofence dwell at 144 seconds, running from 13:31:56 to 13:34:20 — a shortfall of 36 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full where the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. Limb (d) fails as well: 180 seconds from 13:31:56 elapses at 13:34:56, and the driver terminated at 13:34:24, 32 seconds early. POL-NS-06(i) cannot lengthen the dwell — the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum — and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02707-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so nothing permits accumulation.

What is returned. The sum is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02707: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The gross figure of SGD 6.61 was never charged on this trip and is not refunded. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-06 states expressly that none is payable where the dwell falls short, and POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

The parties' arguments. The driver's claim that limb (d) is satisfied by the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is rejected in part: the code is one of the three limb (d) recognises, but limb (d) also requires the termination to fall at or after the required dwell elapsed, which it did not. The driver's point that nothing supports withholding compensation or escalating is accepted so far as the anti-farming test goes — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against 54 completed trips in 30 days, so the POL-NS-07 check does not trip, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged — but it does not help him keep the fee, because POL-NS-06 independently refunds it. The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04, as the driver correctly says: the driver replied 'ok' at 13:33:11, 15 seconds after her 13:32:56 message, and no in-app call is recorded, so limb (b) closes that route. That does not matter, because the refund follows from the dwell shortfall, not from the contact route. The driver's attack on the rider's account of the timing is not made out: a 144-second wait is two minutes and twenty-four seconds, which is essentially the 'barely two minutes' she described. The rider's account that the driver said she was 'not visible' is contradicted by his own record — EV-GPS-02707's rider track holds 45 qualifying fixes within about 19 m of the pickup pin throughout, and her lobby message was read — but this goes to credibility only, since POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of presence.

Confidence. The deciding fact — the 144-second dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-02707, which is admissible with no issues at weight 1.0. No artifact carrying that fact is impaired, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is set at 0.95. The only zero-weight artifact, EV-ADVIS-02707-01, carries no fact in this ruling.

Ruling for the rider, and the reasoning in plain language for both of you. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded to the rider in full; no driver compensation is payable; the fee was collected as a rider-filed charge and is returned. The amount is read from the money block: fare_breakdown.total_charged 4.50 and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 4.50 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically.

The fee cannot stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and limb (b) fails. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02709 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, 86 fixes, no gap over 120 s) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class: his closest approach across the whole trip is 647.3 m and the count of qualifying in-radius fixes is 0. On that evidence POL-NS-02 finds the driver never arrived, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not met. The driver's own advocate concedes exactly this on the same numbers, so it is common ground.

The 'I'm Here' event at 07:38:35 is a false arrival marker. The record shows the marker was the driver's own button press (platform_policy.arrival_marker BUTTON), and at that timestamp the trace placed him more than 300 m from the pin — indeed never closer than 647.3 m at any fix. Under POL-NS-05 the marker does not start the waiting clock; the clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and because no such fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund of the cancellation fee, no driver compensation, and the false-arrival record set out in the referrals. Independently, POL-NS-06 gives the same result: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s.

The driver's surviving points, and why they do not change the outcome. Limbs (a) and (d) are indeed met — there is an 'arrived' event at 07:38:35, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:43:37 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event — but limbs (a) and (d) alone do not carry the fee; limb (b) is measured from the trace and fails. The 302 seconds between the arrival tap (07:38:37 wait-timer start) and the 07:43:37 cancellation is real time, but limb (c) and POL-NS-05 both measure the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and there is no such fix; so the long wait does not save the charge. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider from the fee's point of view — the driver replied at 07:39:45, 30 seconds after the rider's 07:39:15 message, inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) is not met — but the rider does not need POL-NS-04, because the refund comes from POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. POL-NS-12 does not apply: it covers only platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, and this record's marker is a driver button press. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver never came within 400 m of the pin, so no wrong-entrance finding and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arise. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 103 (rate 0.0097), below both limbs — so no compensation is withheld on that ground, and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation follows.

The rider's surviving points are accepted as corroboration. The rider track carries 60 qualifying fixes at a mean 10.4 m and maximum 13.8 m from the pin, all stationary, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius; this supports the rider's account and answers the driver's statement that the rider did not come, though the refund does not depend on it. The rider's observation that the driver wrote 'im here already' at 07:39:45 while the only admissible position record puts him at least 647.3 m away is accepted: the chat is consistent with the rider's version of events.

One rider claim was removed by the referee and is not relied on: the argument that POL-NS-06(i) is closed by the absent traffic advisory was discarded because it cited the MISSING artifact EV-ADVIS-02709-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) without naming the issue code. Nothing turns on it; the advisory is absent, so no accumulation of intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available in any event, and the refund rests on the shortfall itself.

Confidence is 0.95. The deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-02709 at weight 1.0, and no artifact below 1.0 carries it; the missing advisory is not the evidence for any deciding fact, and the trace is complete with no gaps, so POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-05 resolves rather than leaves the arrival conflict, the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no_show_disputes_30d is 1. The case is therefore decided, not escalated.

Rider, the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. Driver, your arrival was genuine, but the fee does not stand because the waiting period was not completed.

Why the fee fails. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and limb (c) fails. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The driver's own trace, EV-GPS-02708, shows a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 229 seconds (run_count 1, longest qualifying run 18:54:34 to 18:58:23), a shortfall of 71 seconds, before the 18:58:27 termination. Limb (d)'s timing requirement fails with it, because the required dwell had not elapsed when he terminated the trip. POL-NS-06 is strict liability on exactly this shortfall - the fee 'is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: the trace holds a single in-geofence interval, and the required traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02708-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) - its absence is disclosed, it carries no fact, and so it neither supports accumulation nor caps confidence.

Why there is no driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it, so driver_compensation_sgd is null. POL-NS-03 does not apply - the driver's fixes are inside the arrival radius and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no wrong-entrance goodwill arises.

What both sides got right. Driver: the 18:54:34 'I'm Here' tap coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, with 24 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius and 0.0 kph in the speed set, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-05 does not fire - there is no false-arrival finding and no driver-education referral. Rider: the POL-NS-04 coordination route does not run, because the driver replied 'ok' 15 seconds after the 18:55:34 message, so limb (b)'s 120-second silence test fails; the refund does not depend on it. Note only that the rider's own track (48 fixes, all within 12.47 m of the pin) does not support the driver's account of an absentee rider, and the rider's 'barely two minutes' is not exact - the dwell was 229 seconds - though the shortfall from the 300 seconds the fee was paid for is real.

Escalation and referrals. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against completed_trips_30d 132, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check cannot trip; both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. No limb of POL-NS-08 fires on the deciding artifacts: EV-GPS-02708 has 100% coverage and a 0.0 s maximum gap, the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd under fee_schedule.resolution_rule. No clause produces a referral.

Amount. The contested amount is exactly the cancellation-fee line: SGD 4.00 charged, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, payment_status CHARGED. Under POL-GEN-03 a FULL_REFUND returns the whole of it. The monetary effect (SGD 4.00) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and so executes on issue. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail on the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02710, weight 1.0, COMPLETE, 100% coverage, 64 fixes, no gaps). The closest of the 64 driver fixes to the Bedok Interchange pickup pin is 517.41 m, against a TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius of 150 m (POL-NS-02; fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m), and the derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. Limb (c) fails as well: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 180 s shortfall, and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on that arithmetic whether or not the rider was present.

The driver's 'arrived' marker at 22:48:55 does not save the charge. Under POL-NS-05 that marker is FALSE: at that timestamp the driver was necessarily more than 300 m from the pin (his nearest fix in the whole trace is 517.41 m), and the trace also shows speeds of 57–63 km/h, i.e. a vehicle in motion. Recomputing the waiting clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix yields none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival entry against the driver. POL-NS-03 cannot apply either, because the driver was never stationary within 400 m of the pin (517.41 m is 117 m past the ceiling); POL-NS-01 itself directs that beyond 400 m the driver never arrived and POL-NS-02 governs.

Driver compensation is refused. POL-NS-07 pays 80% only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-01 fails at limb (b), and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06 each independently displace the charge. The anti-farming test does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 2, completed_trips_30d 93, rate 0.0215), and prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only — it was mentioned solely to say it cannot be used, and it carries no finding here.

On the driver's escalation argument, I do not order escalation under POL-NS-09(b). The apparent conflict between the trip record's arrival-and-wait entry and the trace is resolved by a clause: POL-NS-05 exists exactly to declare an arrival marker false when the trace puts the driver more than 300 m away at that timestamp, and its limb (ii) fixes the outcome where no in-geofence fix exists. A ground that asks whether a clause resolves the conflict is answered from the clause, and it does. No other POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The deciding artifacts (EV-GPS-02710, EV-TRIP-02710) are both COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issue codes and no POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, far above the 0.70 floor; the same-party dispute counters under POL-NS-09(c) are 0 for both parties and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 under POL-NS-09(d).

Rider presence is recorded for completeness: her track (54 fixes, all qualifying, farthest 8.59 m from the pin, inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius) supports her account and contradicts the driver's counter-statement that 'the rider did not come'. POL-NS-04 does not itself exonerate her, because the driver replied within 120 seconds (her message 22:49:35, his reply 22:50:05), so limb (b) is unmet; the refund rests on POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02710-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). It carries no fact and is cited only for its absence, so it neither raises nor lowers the cap; POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation is unavailable, which changes nothing because the dwell is 0 s.

Outcome: FULL_REFUND of the whole contested SGD 4.50 to the rider, with no driver compensation. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: the rider's claim is upheld, and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is refunded in full.

What the record shows. The driver accepted the trip at 20:22:12 on 17 Aug, pressed 'arrived' at 20:28:14 and cancelled at 20:32:36 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-02711). The platform charged the rider SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02711: total_charged 4.50, cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

Arrival fails. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02711, weight 1.0, COMPLETE, 69 fixes at a 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0) places the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at 156.99 m anywhere in the trip, with 0 fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and 0 continuous in-geofence runs. POL-NS-02's proximity test therefore fails, and with it POL-NS-01 limb (b): the driver did not arrive at the pickup point. POL-NS-12 does not help the driver - arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so a pressed marker stays subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05, and the bare statement that he 'was at the pickup as shown on the map' is corroborated by no telemetry.

Dwell fails independently. The free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s, measured - per POL-NS-01(c) - from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. POL-NS-06 therefore makes the fee not chargeable on a 180 s shortfall, with no driver compensation, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) cannot be met either because the dwell never elapsed. The driver's contrary point, that 262 s elapsed between the tap and the cancellation against a 180 s period, is rejected: that interval is the platform's wait timer, not the dwell the clause measures from the GPS clock, which never began. The rider's point that nothing can be accumulated is accepted: EV-ADVIS-02711-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0; cited for its absence, which is citable), so POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable, accumulation is defeated, and the 180 s stands unreduced.

Wrong-entrance reading changes nothing. The driver's nearest position, 157 m, is outside the 50 m radius but inside the 400 m ceiling of POL-NS-03, so even on the reading that he attended the wrong face of the venue the rider is still refunded in full; POL-NS-03 decides the refund exactly as POL-NS-02 does. Its compensation allocation goes against the driver: the rider named her sub-location in the chat log at 20:28:34 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A'), the driver read it and answered only 'ok' at 20:29:04, and the trace never shows him closing the last 157 m before he cancelled - limb (i) puts the loss on the driver. Limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill does not apply because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more.

Other points answered. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider (the driver replied within 120 s, 30 s after her message, read 10 s later), but it does not need to - the refund follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06. POL-NS-05 records no false-arrival finding and produces no referral: its test reads the fix matched to the 20:28:14 marker, the driver's nearest approach anywhere in the trace is 156.99 m (inside its 300 m leash) and the trace carries stationary samples, so neither trigger - over 300 m, or 15 km/h or more - is established.

Integrity, confidence and escalation. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08: the trace is COMPLETE with no (a) clock skew and no (b) trace defect; the chat log holds 2 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count, with no sequence gap (c); and the 4.50 cancellation line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 (d). The deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.9. POL-NS-09 is not engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the arrival event and the trace are reconciled by POL-NS-01(b)/POL-NS-02/POL-NS-12 rather than left in unresolved contradiction; both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 87 completed trips, rate 0.023); and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was used for nothing.

The money. The refund is the cancellation-fee line only - 4.50, which is the whole of total_charged (base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee and waiting_time_fee are all 0.00). driver_compensation_sgd is null, and referrals is empty. The monetary effect of 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue; this is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04.

Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs. Limbs (a) and (d) are recorded: the trip record carries the driver's arrival event at 12:30:36 and a driver termination at 12:34:59 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW (one of the three codes limb (d) recognises). But limb (b) and limb (c) fail. This is a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-02712, pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, not 50 m, and the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02712) never places him inside it: his closest approach to the pin is 258.2 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), the qualifying in-radius fix count is 0, and the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 s. The driver's closest approach (258.2 m) sits outside the 120 m radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so POL-NS-03 independently refunds in full — he did not arrive at the pickup point. Both routes (POL-NS-02 for a trace with no in-radius fix at all, POL-NS-03 for a stationary position within 400 m) end in the same full refund, and the driver advocate properly concedes the fee is not chargeable.

Why there is no driver payment. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (b) fails and POL-NS-06 independently displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 puts the loss on the driver for compensation purposes: the rider stated a specific sub-location in the chat log at 12:30:56 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A', EV-CHAT-02712) and the driver did not move to it before cancelling at 12:34:59. The driver's anti-farming position (claim 5) is correct as far as it goes — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 92, so neither limb of the POL-NS-07 check trips, and those are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test — but it changes nothing, because no compensation route is reached.

The rider's POL-NS-04 point is not needed and does not carry her case: the driver replied 'ok' at 12:31:26, within 120 seconds of the rider's 12:30:56 message, so the clause does not exonerate her on driver non-response. Her presence is in fact affirmatively established (54 qualifying rider fixes, never more than 19.9 m from the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius), which contradicts the RIDER_NO_SHOW label, but the refund follows from the driver's own trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 regardless. Her point that the 12:30:36 event is a driver-pressed marker is accepted: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not convert that tap into a platform-confirmed arrival. Confidence and effect. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02712-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact relied on here. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02715 does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full. No compensation is paid to the driver.

What the record establishes. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 10:06:17 and EV-GPS-02715 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that moment: 44 qualifying fixes in one unbroken in-geofence run of 420 seconds, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold cuts the dwell down). He cancelled at 10:13:19 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code POL-NS-01(d) recognises, with no boarding event and a null started_at. On the driver-side evidence alone POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) hold, no POL-NS-05 false-arrival issue arises (he was inside the radius, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h trigger, so the clock needs no recomputation), and POL-NS-07 would fix his payout at SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the fare ledger's derived money block states the same figure). The anti-farming check is clean: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against completed_trips_30d of 134 is a rate of 0.007, below the 0.08 limb; both limbs must trip together and neither does.

Why the fee is nevertheless refunded. POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01 where three conditions hold, and all three hold here. (a) EV-CHAT-02715 carries two rider messages inside the waiting window - 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47 - both locating or coordinating on their face, and the log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, so nothing is missing from the exchange. (b) The driver posted no reply, both rider messages carry read_at null, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array; the cancellation came at 10:13:19, six and a half minutes after the first message, so the 120 second reply window had expired twice and no call was made. (c) The rider track inside EV-GPS-02715 has 67 of 67 qualifying fixes (not one filtered out), with a greatest distance of 20.89 m from the pickup pin and a mean of 17.66 m - well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m, and inside even the 50 m radius the driver's own arrival test uses. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider, refunds the cancellation fee in full and makes no driver compensation payable. The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is accepted as far as it goes and the trace confirms it, but waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and a driver who holds position while a rider about 21 m away messages him twice without answer has not met the coordination duty the clause enforces; the driver's own submission does not contest these coordination facts. POL-NS-01 is explicit that the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces its limbs, and POL-NS-04 is that clause.

Evidence integrity. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08. Clock skew is 0 seconds (the arrival event 10:06:17 coincides with the nearest fix); the trace holds 84 fixes, 100.0 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence, no gaps and a 0.0 second maximum gap, so POL-NS-08(b) is not approached; the chat log reconciles with chat_message_count; and the fare ledger's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the net fee produced by the resolution rule (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact sits at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and no discounted- or impaired-evidence narration is engaged.

The missing traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; no advisory covers this pickup in this window. It is disclosed rather than relied on: it carries no fact, makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, and decides nothing here, the dwell being a single unbroken 420 second interval that needs no accumulation.

Escalation and referrals. To the rider and the driver. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02714 is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver SGD 2.25 as a goodwill payment.

Why the fee does not stand. A no-show fee needs the driver to have actually reached the pickup point. POL-NS-01(b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB bay at or before the arrival event. EV-GPS-02714 is a complete trace — 97 fixes, 100% coverage, a 10 s cadence and no gaps — and it yields 0 qualifying fixes inside the radius; the driver's closest recorded approach to the pin anywhere in the trip was 272.98 m. The driver's 09:19:17 'I'm Here' tap is a status the driver set, not a platform measurement, and cannot supply the arrival limb (b) requires; nor do the 331 s wait timer or the RIDER_NO_SHOW code in EV-TRIP-02714 cure it. Limb (c) fails too: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec). Limb (d) fails as well, and the rider's own track places her device 2.29 m to 9.36 m from the pin on all 63 of her fixes, so the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code is not supported. Under POL-NS-02 the rider is entitled to a full refund of the SGD 4.50, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full no POL-NS-07 compensation (80% of the net fee, SGD 3.60) arises.

Why the driver still receives SGD 2.25. POL-NS-03 governs where the driver's closest position is outside the 150 m arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and 272.98 m is inside that ceiling; the driver marked arrival while close to the pin but not inside the radius, and POL-NS-05's own closing words send that situation to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-05 does not declare the marker false: its distance trigger needs more than 300 m and 272.98 m is short of it, and no fix is matched to the marker for its speed trigger. Under POL-NS-03 the cancellation fee is refunded in full whatever the fault finding. On the driver's loss: EV-CHAT-02714 names no entrance, block, tower or bay — the rider's only message is 'cant see you' — so limb (i) does not strip the driver of compensation; and with trip_record.registered_pickup_points = 2, limb (ii) attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party and fixes platform-funded goodwill of 50% of the SGD 4.50 fee, SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. That payment is independent of, and never netted against, the rider's refund.

Two further points. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the driver replied to the rider's 09:20:57 message at 09:21:47, 50 seconds later and inside the 120 second window, so limb (b) fails and the residual question is decided under POL-NS-03 — both advocates accept this. And the request to escalate is refused: there is no unresolved contradiction between two admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence, because the trip record's arrival entry is the driver's own button press rather than a platform position measurement, and POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-03 resolve where the driver actually was. None of the other POL-NS-09 triggers fires: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, and driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 137 completed trips in 30 days (rate 0.007), nowhere near the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test, so no compensation is withheld and no anti-farming escalation arises. driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags = 1 is lifetime context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not substituted for the 30-day figure.

Confidence and execution. Every artifact this ruling rests on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 — EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714, EV-CHAT-02714 and EV-FARE-02714 — and the fare ledger reconciles to the SGD 4.50 in platform_policy, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect applies; no POL-NS-08(a)–(c) impairment is present either (no clock skew, no trace gap, chat intact). Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. EV-ADVIS-02714-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but it carries no deciding fact and does not cap confidence; the claim relying on it without naming its issue code was discarded at the mechanical check. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50 + SGD 2.25 = SGD 6.75, at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
The charge turns on one number: how long the driver held the pickup. Both parties agree the driver reached the pin and tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:38:37, and that he terminated the trip at 22:41:36. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the arrival tap. The free period in force is read from the record: trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 seconds. The platform's own GPS trace measures a single continuous in-geofence run of 179 seconds (19 qualifying fixes, 22:38:37 to 22:41:36, closest fix 0.31 m from the pin). That is one second short of 180. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and limb (d) fails with it: 180 seconds from 22:38:37 elapses at 22:41:37, and the driver cancelled at 22:41:36. Because the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06 governs - where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded. To the driver: your point that the arrival marker was true, that you were stationary on the pin the whole time and that the trace runs on to 22:42:46, is accepted - POL-NS-02 is satisfied (19 consecutive accuracy-qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius) and POL-NS-05 does not fire (0.0 km/h at the pin at 22:38:37). But POL-NS-02 decides arrival, not dwell. Your argument that the one-second gap is a boundary effect of the 10-second export cadence is understood and is factually plausible, but POL-NS-06 is deliberately strict liability - the policy states that even a rider who was genuinely absent gets the fee back where the driver cancelled a few seconds early - and there is no de minimis allowance anywhere in the category. The shortfall also cannot be bridged: POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only against a present, populated traffic_advisory, and EV-ADVIS-02717-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), while the trace shows a single interval (run_count 1). POL-NS-07 accordingly pays you nothing: it applies only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and here POL-NS-01 fails and POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the 3.60 SGD payout is not owed; nor does the anti-farming check arise (no_show_terminations_30d 2, below the 4-limb, rate 0.022, below 0.08). To the rider: your account that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not what the record shows - he was en route 8.3 minutes and waited 2 minutes 59 seconds - and POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you (you sent no message, and your device track sits about 900 m from the pin). You succeed on the dwell arithmetic alone, which POL-NS-06 makes decisive regardless of rider presence. Integrity: the fare ledger's cancellation-fee line of 4.50 reconciles exactly with the platform fee of 4.50, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect; the trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100% coverage and no gaps, and the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count, so no POL-NS-08 limb fires and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is presented. The ruling rests on EV-GPS-02717 and EV-TRIP-02717, both at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0. The refund of 4.50 SGD is at or below the 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. No clause produces a referral.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties are looking at the same record, so here is what it shows.

The driver did arrive and wait. The trip record logs the 'I'm Here' tap at 19:24:52, the GPS trace shows an unbroken hold inside the pickup geofence of 471 seconds across 47 qualifying fixes (19:24:52 to 19:32:43), and the trip was cancelled at 19:32:46 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. Standing alone, the four limbs of POL-NS-01 are met, and the driver's statement that he waited the full time is true as far as the dwell goes.

But POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it here. All three of its limbs hold. (a) The chat log shows the rider sent two coordinating messages inside the waiting window — 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 19:25:22 and 'hello? are you here' at 19:27:22. Each is a request for the driver's position and a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle, which is exactly the content limb (a) names. (b) The driver neither replied nor called: the chat log contains no driver message and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. (c) The rider's own track places the device within 12.1 m of the pin on all 85 qualifying fixes across the window, far inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius.

The driver's two arguments do not change this. The point that the rider 'named no entrance, block, tower or bay' fails because limb (a) is disjunctive — a request for the driver's position or a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle each satisfies it, and both are present. The point that the rider 'never boarded' is true but irrelevant: the clause turns on the three limbs, not on boarding. Because POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01, the $3.60 driver_compensation figure in the fare ledger does not arise — POL-NS-04 grants the refund 'with no driver compensation payable', and POL-NS-07 compensates only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01.

On the evidence: EV-ADVIS-02716-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. It carries no fact for either side; POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run without it, but nothing needs it, because the driver's hold is a single continuous in-geofence run. No artifact below weight 1.0 carries any deciding fact, so the confidence cap is 1.0.

No escalation applies. POL-NS-09(d) is not tripped — rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3, and the anti-farming check reads 2 no-show terminations against 58 completed trips, below both the count and the rate thresholds; the counterparty counts are 0; no two artifacts contradict each other; and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. Only the trailing-window counters are citable for those tests, and the driver's mention of prior_no_show_flags is a context-only lifetime counter that was expressly not relied on.

Amount: the full contested cancellation fee of $4.50 is refunded to the rider (fare_breakdown cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That is below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

To the rider: your dispute is not upheld, and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee stands as charged (EV-FARE-02718: cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Your driver accepted at 20:32:01, reached the pickup point at 20:36:57, and cancelled at 20:39:58 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions and each holds: (a) EV-TRIP-02718 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 20:36:57; (b) EV-GPS-02718 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same moment, with 19 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes where the clause needs 3; (c) he held position in the geofence for a continuous 181 seconds (EV-GPS-02718, longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec = 181.0) against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180); and (d) no boarding was recorded, and the trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 20:39:58, after the dwell elapsed. Your submission that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported by that sequence. Your argument that the platform's own wait timer shows 179 seconds (started 20:36:59, cancelled 20:39:58) is rejected: POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event or the platform timer, and that is the 181-second run. The 2-second gap between the first in-geofence fix (20:36:57) and the timer start (20:36:59) is timer lag, not a shortfall. POL-NS-12 (which would treat the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events as an independent carrier) applies only to a GPS_AUTO marker; here platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, so the qualifying-fix test governs. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall claim therefore fails: derived shortfall_sec is -1.0, a surplus, so nothing is refunded. Your further submission that the wait clock is unmeasurable and the case should go to human review is rejected for the same reason: the clause fixes the measurement, 181.0 seconds against 180, so there is no unresolved conflict between admissible artifacts. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you either: limb (a) requires a rider locating message, and EV-CHAT-02718 holds one message, the driver's own at 20:37:17 ('im at the pickup point', read 20:37:47), with no rider reply; separately, your device's 41 fixes lie 874.8-880.9 m from the pin (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against a 100 m radius). POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so under POL-NS-07 you receive 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: EV-DPROF-02718 records 0 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 62 completed trips, so neither limb is met, nothing is withheld and no escalation follows. The fee itself is unchanged - the rider's charge stands - and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd, being the amount this ruling moves. Confidence: every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-GPS-02718, EV-TRIP-02718, EV-FARE-02718, EV-DPROF-02718) carries weight_multiplier 1.0 and status COMPLETE, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor fixed by POL-NS-09. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: no counter-party dispute history (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), no abuse counter (rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1), no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts that a clause leaves unresolved, and no deciding fact resting on impaired evidence. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. ruling.explanation:
The dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02719 — the only amount contested, and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The driver ended the trip at 07:45:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the fee stands.

FOR THE DRIVER. Every condition of the baseline no-show clause (POL-NS-01) holds. (a) The trip record carries the 'I'm Here' arrival event at 07:39:37. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02719) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same moment — the longest qualifying in-geofence run starts exactly at 07:39:37 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) and contains 37 qualifying fixes. (c) That hold is continuous for 360 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 180 seconds; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. (d) No boarding is recorded, and the cancellation at 07:45:40 falls after the required dwell elapsed (07:42:37), under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes the clause recognises. Nothing displaces the fee: POL-NS-05 does not bite (the marker coincides with the first qualifying fix, and the closest approach is 41.42 m, far inside the 300 m trigger); POL-NS-06 does not bite (the dwell exceeds the minimum rather than falling short); POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver was inside the radius, not outside it); POL-NS-10 does not apply (the driver, not the rider, cancelled). Compensation therefore follows at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force: SGD 3.60, the same figure the payments ledger computes under POL-NS-07. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1 divided by 133 completed trips in 30 days is 0.0075, below the 0.08 limb — so compensation is paid, not withheld.

FOR THE RIDER. Your account that the driver 'parked a bit away' is borne out by the driver's own trace: his closest approach to the pickup pin across the whole trip was 41.42 m (driver_track.min_distance_m), while your device sat 2.73 to 10.55 m from that pin on 66 of 66 fixes. But 41.42 m is still inside the 50 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for a STANDARD pickup, so it does not make the fee unchargeable — the driver had arrived within the policy's meaning, and his statement that he was 'right at the pin' is loose rather than decisive. Your strongest route, the rider-contact clause (POL-NS-04), fails at its first condition: it requires at least one message from you during the waiting window whose content locates or coordinates (your own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that you cannot see the vehicle), and your only message was 'ok' at 07:41:07, sent in reply to the driver's 'here'. 'ok' names no place, asks for nothing and tells the driver nothing about where you were — it is an acknowledgement, not locating or coordinating content, and the clause's enumerated content test is not met by it. The clause's other two conditions do hold — the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call before cancelling, and your track sits inside the 100 m presence radius on every fix — but POL-NS-04 requires all three, so it cannot exonerate you and the fee is not refunded. The wrong-entrance route (POL-NS-03) is closed because the driver was inside the arrival radius rather than outside it, and its pin-ambiguity goodwill branch is closed because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not the 2 or more that branch requires.

ON EVIDENCE. EV-ADVIS-02719-01 (traffic advisory, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) has no payload and carries no fact; it is not relied on and changes nothing. The GPS trace, trip record, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles are each COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, with 100 percent GPS coverage, a 10-second cadence and a 0-second maximum gap inside the waiting window, and the fare line reconciles to the SGD 4.50 charged. The confidence cap is therefore 1.0, and no POL-NS-08 impairment or POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present.

OUTCOME. The contested SGD 4.50 fee is not refunded to the rider — it stands as charged. The driver is paid SGD 3.60, and the same figure appears in amount_sgd, which on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling is the amount the ruling moves rather than a second payment.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 12:31:25, started the wait timer at 12:31:27 and cancelled at 12:37:28 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event. But a no-show fee needs all four conditions of POL-NS-01, and two fail. The pickup is a STANDARD zone, so POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m and requires at least three consecutive qualifying fixes inside it. Across the driver's complete 73-fix trace (100% coverage, 10 s cadence, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s) his closest recorded position to the pin was 53.08 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m) — outside the 50 m radius — and the derived arrival facts return 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s. Limb (b) therefore fails, and limb (c) fails with it, because the required 180 s dwell (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) must be served inside the geofence and none was. The driver's argument that a 3.08 m margin should be excused by the 25 m accuracy filter is rejected: the filter is applied fix by fix within the policy's own test, and on that test no fix qualifies, so the record describes a driver who stopped a few metres short of the pickup point, not one who arrived. His further point that he waited 361 s from the tap does not help, because limb (c) measures continuous in-geofence dwell, not time elapsed since the button press. Likewise his assertion that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own instrument, and the rider's device track (66 qualifying fixes, all stationary, 14.62–20.74 m from the pin, still there after the cancellation) shows the rider was present, so she did not simply fail to appear. Because the driver's stationary position lay outside the radius but well inside 400 m (53.08 m), the fee is decided under POL-NS-03: the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded in full. On fault allocation, POL-NS-03(i) does not apply because the rider never named an entrance, block, tower or bay — her only message was 'ok' — and POL-NS-03(ii) does not apply because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. No pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable, and no driver compensation arises: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. POL-NS-04 does not independently exonerate the rider because 'ok' is not a locating or coordinating message, but the refund does not depend on it. POL-NS-12 does not assist the driver because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. No escalation applies: the trace is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) (no gaps, full coverage, and the 4.50 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd so limb (d) is satisfied), the chat log reconciles with trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) fires, and confidence (0.90) is above the 0.70 floor. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it is not relied on — POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable, and with run_count 0 there are no separate in-geofence intervals to accumulate in any event, so the missing advisory does not affect this outcome. To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02723 (fare breakdown EV-FARE-02723, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full.

The ground is limb (d) of POL-NS-01. That limb requires the trip to have been ended by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02723) shows it was ended by the driver at 12:06:23 under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which the clause states in terms is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The driver's chat message of 12:00:29 ('cannot find you, where are you') and his statement 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' say the same thing. The driver does not ask the Judge to read that code as one of the three, and the failure is dispositive: the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause (Rider claim 1 accepted; Driver claim 7 accepted only as a labelling error, whose consequence POL-NS-01 fixes as below).

The driver did reach the pickup and did wait. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02723, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) places him 0 m from the pin and stationary at the 11:59:59 'I'm Here' tap, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and the arrival marker is not false (Driver claim 3 accepted). He then held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 380 seconds, 11:59:59 to 12:06:19, against the 180-second free waiting period in force on this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). There is therefore no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06 (Driver claim 4 accepted) and limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied (Driver claim 2 accepted). Limb (c) alone does not make the fee chargeable, because limb (d) breaks.

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 states the consequence itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the referrals as a driver-education item. That is this ruling (Rider claim 2 accepted). The rider's own conduct does not alter it: POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider — she sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 12:00:59; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of it nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and her device recorded 67 qualifying fixes, all within about 15.5 m of the pin, well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius (Rider claim 3 accepted). Both routes agree.

Driver compensation: none. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) is not, so the condition precedent fails and the payout is never reached (Rider claim 4 accepted). The anti-farming test is not the reason — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against 114 completed trips in 30 days, so the check would not trip (Driver claim 6 correct on that point) — but compensation simply does not arise. The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags (2) is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was correctly not used as a ground by either side.

POL-NS-03 does not govern: it applies where the stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, and here they lie inside. The rider's alternative reasoning under it is therefore not reached, and nothing in it changes the outcome (Rider claim 5 not engaged).

Amount: the sum returned is the cancellation-fee line, SGD 4.50, matching fare_breakdown.total_charged (4.50) and platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50); no booking, platform or waiting-time fee is added, and the waiting-time line is 0.00 (Rider claim 6 accepted). No fare-integrity defect arises under POL-NS-08(d) — the line reconciles with a reported difference of SGD 0.00 (Driver claim 5 accepted).

No escalation: every deciding fact is carried by unimpaired artifacts at weight 1.0, the GPS trace and the trip record, so no POL-NS-08 cap applies and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The one impaired artifact, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02723-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0), carries no deciding fact and is relied on by neither party for one (Rider claim 7 accepted). Confidence 0.95, capped at the minimum weight (1.0) among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically on issue. This is a provisional automated ruling; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
