the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02760-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ruling.explanation:
The no-show charge stands, and the driver is paid. The ride record and the driver's GPS trace agree on everything that matters. The driver tapped 'arrived' at 10:43:34, and the GPS trace independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0; 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes). He then held position continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, so he waited 260 seconds longer than the minimum. He terminated the trip at 10:50:57 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that period had run, and the record shows no boarding. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: it is corroborated by a fix inside the radius at the tap second (no >300 m distance and no 15 km/h motion), and even on a recomputed clock the 440-second dwell still clears the 180-second minimum. POL-NS-03 has no application because the driver was inside the radius, not merely within 400 m of the pin, and POL-NS-06 does not fire because there is no shortfall (the derived figure is a 260-second surplus). The rider's argument is POL-NS-04, and it fails on its own terms: limbs (a) and (b) are met (she sent 'im at the pickup, cant see you' at 10:44:14, the driver never replied within 120 seconds and never placed an in-app call, trip_record.in_app_calls being empty), but limb (c) cannot be run at all because the GPS trace carries no rider track (rider_presence.available is false, rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable and neutral: I do not infer the rider was elsewhere, but POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee, which is the 3.60 stated in the fare breakdown's money block; the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and 0 of 70 completed trips is 0.0, both below the clause's thresholds). On the fee itself the rider's claim is not supported: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the 4.50 charge stays as it is. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd, per POL-GEN-03. The single traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02758-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is relied on by nobody; its absence costs the driver nothing because his dwell is one unbroken interval needing no accumulation. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present (no contradicting artifacts, no repeat-dispute pattern, no anti-farming trip, no impaired sole evidence), and the monetary effect of 3.60 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically. No referral is produced, since POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged by a corroborated marker.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and to the driver: the $4.50 charged is real (EV-FARE-02756: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), but neither side can presently establish the fact the fee depends on, so the fee is held rather than collected or refunded.

The case turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180; no_show_threshold_sec null). Arrival itself is not the difficulty: the POL-NS-02 geofence test is met on the fixes the trace does carry - STANDARD zone radius 50 m, 22 qualifying in-radius fixes, the first at 11:32:47, the same moment as the 'arrived' event - and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (nothing places the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at that timestamp), so no false-arrival referral arises. The difficulty is the dwell, and the only artifact that measures it - EV-GPS-02756 - is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and impaired at policy level too under POL-NS-08(b), because its 197-second sampling gap from 11:33:47 to 11:37:04 lies inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold.

That gap falls exactly across the stretch that decides limb (c). The admitted in-geofence runs are 60 seconds (11:32:47-11:33:47) and 143 seconds (11:37:04-11:39:27); the longest uninterrupted run is 143 seconds, 37 seconds short of 180. Whether the driver held the geofence throughout the gap - which would make one continuous 400-second dwell and support the fee and a $3.60 payout (80 percent of $4.50) - or left and re-entered - leaving 143 seconds and giving the rider the full $4.50 back under POL-NS-06 - is precisely what the trace does not show. The limb is therefore undecided over the impaired stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor the refund.

I do not accept either way around that. First, the driver's 400-second run and trip_record.wait_time_min 6.7 do not independently establish the dwell: POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, and this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 - which makes the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace - does not apply. The trip record therefore does not carry the dwell fact, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 0.39, not the maximum of 0.39 and 1.0, and the $3.60 compensation cannot be ordered. The driver's statement that he waited the full time is evidence, but it carries no weight_multiplier and no clause of this category makes a counterparty statement the test for limb (c). Second, the 60-second and 143-second intervals cannot be summed: POL-NS-06(i) permits summing only where a present, populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-02756-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). So 203 seconds cannot be assembled, the 197-second gap cannot be scored as waiting time, and the rider's 143-second shortfall cannot be treated as a decided fact either - it is the reading the trace gives once the gap is refused, but the gap is exactly what could make the dwell sufficient.

Other points, briefly. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds 0 messages, so limb (a) fails (EV-CHAT-02756). The absent rider track leaves limb (c) of POL-NS-04 undecidable and neutral under POL-NS-11, and does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence. The fare line reconciles (4.50 equals 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against 85 completed trips in 30 days), and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (both paired-dispute counters 0; no_show_disputes_30d 0). The driver's prior_no_show_flags of 2 is a lifetime counter and context only; it is not a ground of decision and I have not used it.

Why the case escalates. The sole evidence for the deciding fact - the in-geofence dwell - is the impaired trace, so POL-NS-08's closing sentence is engaged and POL-NS-09(e) applies; and because the ruling rests on an artifact at 0.39, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well. Escalation is terminal: no refund and no compensation issue, and the $4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded. The monetary effect is nil; the sums in play, $4.50 and $3.60, are each below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00. Referrals: none - POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07's packet instruction are the only candidates on these facts and neither fires.

The open question for the human reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record for TRP-02756, did the driver remain inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius throughout 11:33:47-11:37:04 (a 400-second continuous dwell, which supports the $4.50 fee and a $3.60 driver payout), or did he leave the radius and re-enter (leaving 143 seconds as the longest run and entitling the rider to a full $4.50 refund under POL-NS-06)?

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider: your $4.50 no-show fee stands, and none of it is refunded. To the driver: the fee is confirmed and you are paid SGD 3.60.

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 needs four things and all four are on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius from the first in-geofence fix at 12:28:24 — 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, far more than the three consecutive readings POL-NS-02 requires. (c) the in-geofence dwell runs unbroken for 482 seconds (12:28:24 to 12:36:26) against the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −302 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed. The arrival marker was not false: the first in-geofence fix coincides with the tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) with the vehicle stationary, so POL-NS-05 corrects nothing and records no false-arrival referral. POL-NS-03 does not govern, because the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the arrival radius rather than outside it.

Why the rider is not exonerated. POL-NS-04 requires a locating message from the rider in the chat; EV-CHAT-02760 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 12:28:49), so limb (a) fails and the clause is never reached. The rider's own track does not support the assertion 'I was there': EV-GPS-02760's rider_presence block puts all 87 rider fixes 806–814 m from the pin, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 100 m STANDARD radius. Rider presence does not decide the fee, so that is context; it also means the rider's claim is unsupported by the rider's own device.

The impaired trace and its effect. EV-GPS-02760 carries weight_multiplier 0.85 and issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60-second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, 1.0 km apart, before the waiting window, on a 93.9%-coverage trace. Under POL-NS-08(b) a gap must exceed 120 seconds and lie inside the waiting window to be a policy-level impairment; this one does neither, so the trace stays usable for arrival and dwell and the case does not escalate. Because arrival and dwell are carried by this trace alone — the arrival marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not let the platform's own events stand as an independent measurement, and the driver's chat message merely repeats the tap — POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at 0.85. The finding survives the discount: the gap sits before the arrival and cannot shorten the measured 482-second run. I reject the suggestion that the arrival test cannot be run for want of per-fix accuracy figures: the derived geometry is authoritative and reports 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, and the pre-pass accuracy note is not evidence of absence.

The money. POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation '3.60'). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, so the count limb fails and no rate computation can change it; compensation is paid, not withheld. The ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.60; the rider's charge itself stands. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02760-01, weight 0.0) plays no part: there is a single unbroken dwell run, so no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is needed, and the fare line reconciles with platform_policy so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. No referral is produced — the arrival marker was true and the reason code was correctly RIDER_NO_SHOW. Confidence 0.85.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02802-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the core arithmetic, and the record supports it. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is the GPS trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 26.44 km (EV-GPS-02801), not the rounded 26.4 km convenience copy on the trip record, against the booked optimal of 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-02801). That is an excess of 5.44 km, or 25.9% — beyond both establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20% — so a route deviation is established. It is below both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation and POL-RD-06 is not engaged: no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). Consistently, the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d = 0 over completed_trips_90d = 191, so no repeat pattern is established.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. That clause applies because the fare model is METERED (fare_breakdown.fare_model, EV-FARE-02801) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route. Surge is taken from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = 1.2 — the only artifact carrying that field — and is not treated as absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 28.4) x 1.2 + 0.80 platform fee = (3.80 + 15.75 + 7.952) x 1.2 + 0.80 = 27.502 x 1.2 + 0.80 = 33.8024. Refund = charged_total 40.71 - 33.8024 = 6.9076, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 6.95. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.97% of charged_total, well below the 90% share that would convert this into a FULL_REFUND, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 6.95.

Nothing is added on top. The fare breakdown carries zero ERP lines, zero tolls, no airport surcharge and a 0.00 waiting-time fee, so POL-RD-09 yields no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity line; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding off-route ERP to the POL-RD-02 figure in any event. No exculpatory clause reduces the excess: the chat log EV-CHAT-02801 holds 0 messages, so there is no POL-RD-04 rider instruction; the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null and both amended optimals null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and billed distance 26.4 km matches the traced 26.44 km, so no POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance compensation arises.

The driver's stated explanation in the counterparty statement — 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road' — is an uncited traffic assertion. Under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip, and there is none on file: EV-ADVIS-02801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal; the deviation stands at the measured figure under POL-RD-13(2). Because the driver named no evidence ID for an advisory, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 208 fixes at a 10-second interval, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s and 100% coverage, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and the escalation in POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02801) and the timestamps are consistent, and the refund is under both SGD 150.00 and charged_total, so no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) adds no corroboration hurdle.

The confidence cap is 1.00: every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 and EV-FARE-02801 — has weight_multiplier 1.0, and the only impaired artifact, the missing advisory, carries nothing. The monetary effect of 6.95 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties largely agree on the arithmetic, and the record supports it. The measured deviation is established but not material. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02803 records 15.52 km between the pickup fix (16:05:14) and the dropoff fix (16:25:24) against the booked optimal route of 11.2 km on EV-TRIP-02803 — an excess of 4.32 km, or 38.57% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), but neither materiality test does (not above 50%, not above 8.0 km), so no material deviation is recorded. The governing figure is the trace distance of 15.52 km; the trip record's rounded 15.5 km copy is not used for the threshold test, and the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 (122 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps), so no independent corroboration of the deviation was needed.

The driver's explanation — 'traffic was heavy so I took another road' — carries no weight. Under POL-RD-13 an asserted external traffic cause is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02803-01, is MISSING: it has no payload and a weight_multiplier of 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. No advisory covers the trip window, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion discharges nothing under POL-RD-08. Because the driver named no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire and the case does not escalate; the excess stands at the measured 4.32 km.

No part of the excess is rider-caused. The chat log EV-CHAT-02803 contains zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no instruction to test and no waypoint to corroborate, and POL-RD-14 is not reached. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 gives no amended optimal and the booked 11.2 km stands as the baseline.

Refund arithmetic under POL-RD-02 (fare model METERED; the surge multiplier of 1.5 is read from the fare breakdown EV-FARE-02803, which is the only artifact carrying it): recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 11.2 optimal km + 0.28 x 15.1 optimal min) x 1.5 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 2.00 ERP on the optimal route = 27.4420. Charged_total is 34.44, so the refund is 34.44 - 27.4420 = 6.9980, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 as SGD 7.00. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 20.3% of charged_total, below the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund of SGD 7.00. Every legitimate line stands: base, distance, time and the 1.5 surge, the platform fee and the on-route ERP; only the distance and time the detour added are stripped out.

The single ERP line ('CTE Braddell southbound', SGD 2.00) is matched to the trace — the nearest fix is 7.52 m away, well inside the 250 m crossing radius — and the fare breakdown records it on the optimal route. It is already comprehended in the recomputed fare and is not added on top (POL-RD-09(1)). There is no off-route and no phantom gantry, so no standalone pass-through correction and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises.

No repeat-deviation pattern exists: EV-DPROF-02803 shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 against completed_trips_90d of 413, far below the POL-RD-06 ratio of 0.05, and the deviation is not material in any event. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral follow. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter mentioned on the same profile is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used for the test.

No driver compensation is due: the billed distance of 15.5 km falls short of the 15.52 km trace by only 0.02 km, below the 1.0 km shortfall POL-RD-04 requires. ruling.explanation:
Rider, your dispute of the metered fare is upheld in part; Driver, the excess distance on this trip is not excused.

THE DEVIATION. This was trip TRP-02802 (11 Sep 2026, Northpoint City to Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4), a metered fare, with a booked optimal route of 11.4 km. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure where the trace and the trip record disagree: EV-GPS-02802 records 14.56 km against the trip record's rounded 14.60 km copy. The excess is 3.16 km, or 27.72% of optimal, which clears both establishment gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (3.16 km is below 8.0 km and 27.72% is below 50%), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 295 trips, far below the pattern thresholds, and POL-GEN-01 confines that check to those two fields only. No driver-conduct referral arises.

TRACE QUALITY. The trace carries 115 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. It fails none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c), so it is not impaired for policy purposes, the excess is measured on it directly, and no independent corroboration is required.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. Driver, your statement that traffic was heavy so you took another road is an external-traffic-cause excuse. Under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. That advisory, EV-ADVIS-02802-01, is MISSING (no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13, the assertion carries no weight. It neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. No rider-requested detour applies (chat log EV-CHAT-02802 carries 0 messages, POL-RD-04), no pickup or drop-off amendment applies (POL-RD-05), and this is not a pooled trip (vehicle type RYDE_X, POL-RD-12).

WHY THIS DOES NOT ESCALATE. The driver's side asks that the case be held under POL-RD-10(5) because the advisory identifier is missing. I decline. POL-RD-13 addresses this exact situation: where the asserting party names no evidence ID for an advisory, the missing advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5) - the absence is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and the deviation stands at the measured figure with POL-RD-02 running against the booked 11.4 km optimal. The driver's own statement names no advisory, and the minted identifier is cited on both sides only as an absence, not as the ground of the excuse. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across the three artifacts, the trace is not impaired, the timestamps agree, and no charge line is unmatched.

THE REFUND (POL-RD-02). The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02802), so POL-RD-11 does not apply; the surge multiplier of 1.0 was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier. charged_total = 20.87. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 11.4 + 0.28 x 15.4) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 16.6620 + 0.80 = 17.4620. Refund = 20.87 - 17.4620 = 3.4080, rounded up to SGD 3.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.3% of charged_total, below the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing separate: there are no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge, no waiting fee and no promo, so nothing is double-counted. On the rider's plea of SGD 2.50, the contested sum is the rider's own estimate, not the policy measure; POL-RD-02 defines the refund as charged_total less the recomputed fare, and on this fare that is SGD 3.45.

OUTCOME. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.45 to the rider; no driver compensation and no referrals. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. All artifacts carrying the deciding facts sit at full weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: this is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over SGD 2.00 on trip TRP-02805. The outcome is NO_ACTION. The fare as charged, SGD 18.54, stands, and nothing is returned to the rider; the payment records (EV-FARE-02805: payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) are left exactly as they are.

Why no deviation exists. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing measurement and forbids citing the trip record's rounded copy for the threshold test. The trace (EV-GPS-02805, status COMPLETE, weight 1.0) records trace_distance_km 12.51; the platform's booked optimal route (EV-TRIP-02805) is 11.8 km. That is an excess of 0.71 km, or 6.02% of optimal. A deviation is ESTABLISHED only if the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. 0.71 km is below 0.8 km and 6.02% is below 20%, so both gates fail and no deviation exists however the trip is characterised. The platform's own derived status for the trace is 'no deviation'. Both sides read the numbers this way: the rider's own filing concedes the threshold is not met, and the driver's advocate reaches the same figure from the same trace. The rider's point that 0.71 km is measured and unexplained is correct, but the policy gives no refund for an unexplained extra 0.71 km that clears neither gate.

Burden (POL-RD-08). The rider's limb (a) is discharged: the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare ledger all carry TRP-02805, and the trace's first and last fixes (16:33:13 and 16:49:33) match trip_record.started_at and ended_at. Fare arithmetic (POL-RD-02). The recomputation clause opens only where a deviation is established, and none is, so it does not run. For completeness on the figures: charged_total was 18.54; a POL-RD-02 recomputation on these inputs gives recomputed_fare 17.9020, a difference of 0.65 — below the SGD 2.00 the rider contested and not payable here because the threshold has not been met.

Pass-through lines (POL-RD-09). Nothing is collectable: no ERP gantry was charged (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00) and no airport surcharge was charged (airport_surcharge 0.00) on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The lines that remain — base fare 3.80, distance 9.38, time 4.56, platform fee 0.80 — are ordinary card amounts with counterparts in the trip record, so there is no phantom or unmatched line, no billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09(4), and no referral.

Other clauses raised. POL-RD-03 / POL-RD-13: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02805-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable; but no party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked, no distance is exonerated and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. POL-GEN-01: every profile field other than the named counters is context only; the rider's rating, account age and prior-dispute figures were not used as grounds for anything, and the driver's profile was used only for the POL-RD-06 test it names.

Confidence and escalation. The deciding fact — the two distances — rests on EV-GPS-02805 and EV-TRIP-02805, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is capped at 1.0 and is set at 0.95. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 99 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 0.0, so the trace supplies the deciding measurement at full weight and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. The rider's own figures (16.91 km against 15.1 km) produce the same 1.81 km and the same 11.99%, and the rider's submission expressly concedes this limb rather than contesting it; that concession is accepted. The driver's submission that the percentage gate fails is also accepted, and the governing figure is the trace's 16.91 km, not the trip record's rounded 16.9 km convenience copy, so the reading is the one most favourable to the driver. The trace is unimpaired: 133 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, admissibility COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, no corroboration question arises, and the measurement stands. Because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation does not open; for transparency, had it opened on this METERED fare it would have given a recomputed fare of 21.637 against a charged total of 23.44, a refund of 1.85 — but no refund is available. The one route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip is a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4), and there is none to make: the fare ledger shows tolls/ERP of 0.00, no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, and its lines reconcile exactly to the charged total of 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 12.68 + time fare 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered — this is neither a MATERIAL deviation nor finely balanced evidence — and even if consulted the citable counters show no pattern (0 deviation flags in 90 days; 0 of 350 completed trips). The chat log holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be shown, waypoint_hint is absent, and no pickup or dropoff amendment under POL-RD-05 exists. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02807-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the driver has not asserted an external traffic cause, so the missing advisory carries nothing and, under POL-RD-13, engages no POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires at all: the three artifacts all carry trip TRP-02807, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, no charge line is unmatched, and the refund computed is nil and far below the 150.00 ceiling. Nor is any driver compensation due under POL-RD-04: the fare was billed on 16.9 km against a trace of 16.91 km, a shortfall of 0.01 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold. The driver's statement that he followed the navigation is not relied on either way: the outcome rests on the measured trace and the clause threshold, not on his account or on any excuse. Both parties: the $29.68 fare stands. The deviation is real, but it is exonerated, and once exonerated the arithmetic returns nothing.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. On the trace figure, which POL-RD-01 makes governing, the trip ran 22.5 km (EV-GPS-02808 trace_distance_km, corroborated by the trip_record copy) against a booked optimal of 18.0 km — an excess of 4.5 km, 25.00% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%). The trace is clean: 177 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07 limbs (a)-(c) do not fire, no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration is needed, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

POL-RD-03 EXONERATES THE EXCESS. The LTA DataMall advisory ADV-20260818-055 (EV-ADVIS-02808-01, weight 1.0, third-party source) names the Pan Island Expressway towards Tuas after the Eunos Link exit — a segment the optimal route traverses, the artifact recording intersects_route true — and its validity window 06:09:18 to 07:33:38 overlaps the trip (06:39:18 to 07:08:38) by 59.3 minutes. Limb (c) is met on the trace's own geometry: the record's closest available test shows 0 fixes inside the advisory area and a minimum approach of 1,203.4 m, which is what a route that leaves the corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after looks like, and the driver's in-app message at 06:40:48 — sent while the trip was running — records 'accident on the PIE ahead, taking the alternative'.

THE EXONERATION IS CAPPED, AND THE CAP DOES NOT BITE. Justified excess = min(4.5 km measured, 1.30 x (21.0 - 18.0) + 1.00 = 4.90 km) = 4.5 km, so the whole measured excess is justified. Limb (c) is not defeated by the trip keeping 1.2 km clear of the incident — staying out of a blocked segment is what avoidance looks like, not evidence against it. Your $4.90 figure is the correct arithmetic against the booked 18.0 km optimal, but POL-RD-03 requires it to be run against the closure-adjusted 22.5 km optimal, where it returns nothing; the fare artifact's closure block (recomputed_fare 29.875, payable 0.00) is that computation, and it applies.

The fare carries no ERP or toll lines (erp_lines empty, total 0.00) and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 has no pass-through correction to add or net off. The deviation is below both POL-RD-01 materiality lines (4.5 km < 8.0 km; 25% < 50%) and the driver's trailing-window figures are deviation_flags_90d 0 over completed_trips_90d 399, so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arise. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so no escalation. Confidence 0.85. The ruling rests on EV-ADVIS-02808-01, EV-GPS-02808, EV-TRIP-02808 and EV-CHAT-02808, each at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes, so nothing caps confidence below that and no POL-GEN-02(3) discount narration is required. The justified excess is min(7.2 km, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km, so the closure-adjusted optimal is 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km, with duration 32.0 x 27.60/24.0 = 36.8 min.

3. The driver's argument that the 3.60 km left over is too small to refund (13.0% of 27.60 km) is not accepted. POL-RD-01 is satisfied on the measured excess (7.2 km, 30.0%), and POL-RD-03 states in terms that the excess beyond the cap is not exonerated and is refunded under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted optimal route - that is exactly this residue. POL-RD-01's 'excess remaining' rule governs the materiality tier (POL-RD-06), which 3.60 km does not reach. Reading POL-RD-01 to re-test establishment on the adjusted optimal would defeat POL-RD-03's express refund in the very cases its cap exists to police.

4. Refund. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02810) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 governs; surge_multiplier 1.0 is read from the fare breakdown. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharge + 0.00 waiting - 0.00 promo = 35.604. Charged_total = 39.40. Refund = 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, rounded up to SGD 3.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and only 9.6% of the fare, so this is a partial refund, not a full one. The rider's higher figure of 7.85 (recomputation against the booked 24.0 km optimal) is not available: the closure-excused stretch comes out before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

5. Nothing is added on top, and nothing else excuses the trip. EV-FARE-02810 carries no ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge (0.00), so there is no separate POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction and no risk of double-counting. There is no amended endpoint (POL-RD-05 not runnable), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The deviation is not material and the driver has no trailing-window pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 196 completed trips), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The rider's claim needs no extra corroboration (deviation_claims_60d 1, below the POL-RD-08 trigger).

Both of you agree on the facts of the trip; you disagree about what the Jurong Point stop does to the fare.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip ran from Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru to Blk 610 Clementi West St 1 on 17 Aug 2026. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02811 (weight 1.0; 207 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s) measures 26.39 km against the platform optimal of 20.3 km on EV-TRIP-02811, an excess of 6.09 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed (more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km absolute), so a deviation is established on the governing trace figure (the rounded 26.4 km copy on the trip record may not be used for this test). The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: no gap over 90 s, no jump over 500 m, no sampling interval over 30 s. The rider's profile does not add the POL-RD-08 corroboration requirement, because deviation_claims_60d on EV-RPROF-02811 is 1, below the threshold of 4.

THE RIDER-REQUESTED STOP (rider claims 1-3; driver claims 1-3, 5). At 06:33:18, sixty seconds after the meter started at 06:32:18 and before the vehicle could have left the optimal corridor, the rider sent MSG-02811-001 from EV-CHAT-02811: 'can we stop at Jurong Point first, need to grab something', carrying the platform-resolved waypoint hint for Jurong Point; the driver replied 'ok' at 06:33:38. The instruction therefore comes from the rider (POL-RD-04(a)), is timely, inside the three-minute allowance (POL-RD-04(b)), and names a place specifically enough to act on (POL-RD-04(c)). The GPS trace corroborates it on the test the clause actually specifies: the nearest fix to the waypoint hint is 21.7 m away, well inside the 200 m threshold (derived.waypoint_approach.within_threshold = true, using the waypoint_hint field and not any act of geocoding). POL-RD-04 is available, and the excess attributable to the rider-requested stop is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

THE RIDER'S QUANTUM OBJECTION (rider claim 6), REJECTED. The rider argues that POL-RD-04 excludes only the excess 'between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor', that no artifact measures that excursion, and that the 6.09 km therefore stands. The clause places no separate quantification burden on the driver: the corroboration it requires is the 200 m field comparison, and that comparison passed. The chat log contains exactly one rider instruction and the trace exactly one waypoint approach, at that same place; no artifact in the bundle evidences any other detour. On this record the measured excess is the rider-requested stop, so once it is excluded no excess remains.

EFFECT. With the excess excluded, neither POL-RD-01 establishment gate is passed, no deviation survives, and POL-RD-02 does not run. The metered charge of SGD 34.00 on EV-FARE-02811 (fare_model METERED; surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, the only artifact that carries the field) stands unchanged. POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION in that situation, and the rider's arithmetic refund claim (rider claim 4) is correct as arithmetic - recomputed_fare 27.497, refund 34.00 - 27.497 = 6.503, rounded up to 6.55 - but it is the calculation that would apply only if no exculpatory clause excused the excess, and POL-RD-04 does. No driver compensation arises under POL-RD-04's second limb: the rider was billed 26.4 km against a trace of 26.39 km, so there is no unbilled shortfall above 1.0 km.

OTHER CLAIMS. The driver's no-repeat-pattern point (driver claim 6) is correct but moot, since no deviation survives; in any event the deviation is not MATERIAL (30% is below 50%, and 6.09 km is below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not triggered and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02811-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on by either side as an external-cause ground - the driver asserts no closure, queue or incident - and its absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, so it triggers no escalation under POL-RD-10(5) or POL-RD-13 (driver claim 7; rider claim 5). No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match, timestamps do not disagree by more than 10 minutes and do not run backwards, the trace is unimpaired, and there are no ERP lines, no airport surcharge and no unmatched charge line (off-route ERP total 0.00). No referral is produced by any clause.

CONFIDENCE. The facts this ruling rests on are carried by EV-CHAT-02811, EV-GPS-02811 and EV-TRIP-02811 - independent artifacts, each at weight_multiplier 1.0 - so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, and my confidence is 0.80. No artifact below weight 1.0 carries the finding. The monetary effect is nil, so nothing is executed under POL-GEN-05, and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 is left as it is. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04, and either may ask for a human decision under POL-GEN-08(3). Any open question about how a future case should quantify a rider-requested excursion is a matter for the policy-gap procedure, not for this ruling.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this is a route-deviation dispute on trip TRP-02812 (RydeX, metered). The telemetry is clean — 107 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10-second sampling, so no POL-RD-07(a)–(c) impairment — and it measures 13.52 km against a booked optimal route of 10.4 km. That is an excess of 3.12 km, or 30.0% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 20% and above 0.8 km) and a deviation is established on this trip's trace alone. The rider's claim that the trace establishes a deviation is accepted, and the trace figure, not the rounded trip-record copy of 13.5 km, governs.

The driver nonetheless has a complete answer under POL-RD-04. Chat message MSG-02812-001, sent by the rider at 10:19:39 — about a minute after the meter started at 10:18:39 and well before the waypoint was reached at 10:27:39 — reads 'can we stop at Paya Lebar Square first, need to grab something'. It comes from the rider, it is timely, and it names a specific, actionable place. The GPS trace corroborates it: the waypoint resolved from chat_message.waypoint_hint (1.381532, 103.831811) is passed within 35.99 m at fix 54, far inside the 200 m test, so this is not the uncorroborated-instruction case in POL-RD-14 and no POL-RD-10(7) contradiction arises. POL-RD-04 therefore applies, and it excludes the excess distance between the vehicle leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor.

On this record that excursion is the whole of the excess. The only off-corridor movement is the single requested waypoint, passed once, with no second waypoint hinted in the chat, no pickup or dropoff amendment on the trip record, and no ERP line in the fare breakdown at all (on-route, off-route and total all 0.00), so there is no other detour the excess could consist of. The requested point sits well off the booked corridor, and the added distance is the natural cost of going there and back. Excluding it leaves no excess meeting POL-RD-01, no deviation survives, and POL-RD-02 — which runs only where a deviation is established — is never reached.

I reject the rider's argument that the driver failed to prove the size of the exonerated stretch. POL-RD-04 requires a corroborated rider instruction, not a separate detour-distance artifact; once the instruction is corroborated, the excursion is excluded by operation of the clause, and the driver discharged his POL-RD-08 burden by pointing to a specific artifact (EV-CHAT-02812) and a specific clause (POL-RD-04). The rider's complaint that they asked only for a 'quick stop, not a tour' does not change where the stop was: the place they named is off the booked route.

The rest of the record changes nothing. EV-ADVIS-02812-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and can carry no fact; POL-RD-13 is not engaged because the driver relies on no external traffic cause, so nothing turns on the absence of an advisory. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 368 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the deviation is not MATERIAL in any event. POL-RD-09 corrects nothing — there are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines, and limb (3) bars an ERP refund where the detour is rider-caused. The rider's serial-claimant corroboration step under POL-RD-08 is not triggered (deviation_claims_60d = 0), and the rider's profile fields are not used against anyone.

Result: NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 this is party-relative — fare_breakdown.payment_status of CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 stand exactly as they are; the rider is not refunded and nothing is taken back from the driver. For completeness, had the deviation survived, POL-RD-02 against the booked optimal would have given charged_total 19.69 less a recomputed_fare of 16.32 = 3.37, rounded up to SGD 3.40; that computation does not run. No clause produces a referral, and the monetary effect of zero is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, so nothing is held and the ruling executes on issue.

This is a provisional automated ruling issued without human review (POL-GEN-08(2)); either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The rider filed; SGD 7.50 is contested on a fare quoted at SGD 21.50 and charged at SGD 28.30. The outcome is a partial refund of SGD 6.80. WHAT IS AGREED AND FOUND. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02813), the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02813) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02813) all carry trip_id TRP-02813 and the trace's first fix (13:59:11) matches the recorded meter start, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trace carries 98 fixes at 10 s with 100% coverage, no gaps and a 0 s maximum gap, so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and no independent corroboration is required; the settlement goes forward on the trace. Under the trace-governs rule of POL-RD-01 the governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km 12.42 km, not the rounded 12.4 km copy on the trip record. Against the booked optimal of 9.2 km the excess is 3.22 km / 35.00%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but clears neither materiality gate (greater than 50% or greater than 8.0 km). Both advocates put the deviation at that level and I accept it: a deviation is ESTABLISHED but is NOT MATERIAL. THE MONEY. The trip is priced on an upfront quote (EV-FARE-02813, fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 21.50). Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and POL-RD-02 does not run, so no distance-or-time refund is available however long the route driven was; the driver's claim to that effect is accepted, and the route-length part of the rider's complaint yields nothing on those lines. The rider's remedy is POL-RD-11(a): charged_total 28.30 less quoted_fare_sgd 21.50 less properly chargeable pass-through and statutory lines 0.00 = 6.80, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 6.80. Nothing changes that figure: there is no ERP or toll line (tolls_erp 0.00, erp_gantries empty), no airport surcharge (0.00, and none could be properly chargeable on a trip from Jurong Point to a Clementi residential block), and waiting_time_fee 0.00, so POL-RD-09 supplies no standalone correction. The refund is therefore 6.80, which is less than the 7.50 contested and less than the whole fare, so the ruling is partial. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's statement, 'the meter adds the extra distance', identifies no traffic cause and no rider instruction; it describes how the fare was computed rather than excusing the route. No traffic advisory covering this trip is on file: EV-ADVIS-02813-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 / POL-RD-13 — I name that artifact, its weight and its issue code as POL-GEN-02(3) requires. Because the driver named no advisory evidence id, this is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited missing artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02813) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04's rider-requested-detour exoneration cannot be attempted (no waypoint_hint, no instruction) and no excess is excluded. No endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null, amended_optimal_distance_km null), so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the 9.2 km booked optimal stands. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 supplies no different baseline. No driver compensation arises: the rider was not billed for less distance than the trace records (no shortfall exceeding 1.0 km), and POL-RD-11 states the driver's unrecovered cost on an unjustified detour is not recoverable from the rider. ESCALATION AND REFERRALS. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers match, the trace is unimpaired and not corroboration-dependent under POL-RD-07, the timestamps agree, no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited missing artifact, the refund is far below SGD 150.00, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No clause produces a referral: the deviation is not material, so POL-RD-06(c) does not fire, and POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to refer (no gantry or surcharge line). The one discarded claim below was discarded by the code referee and plays no part. EXECUTION AND CONFIDENCE. The monetary effect, 6.80, does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes on issue, subject to appeal. The deciding fact — the amount charged over the quote — is carried by EV-FARE-02813 at weight 1.0, and the establishment facts by EV-GPS-02813 and EV-TRIP-02813, both at 1.0; the MISSING advisory carries no fact. The confidence cap is therefore 1.0 and my confidence is 0.95.

No rider-requested detour can be invoked (EV-CHAT-02814 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run), no endpoint was amended (amended_optimal_distance_km, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run), and this is not a pooled trip (vehicle_type RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not re-base the comparison). ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver — this ruling decides DSP-02816 on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare ledger for TRP-02816.

ROUTE DEVIATION: NONE. Both sides read the trace the same way and they are right. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess exceeds 20% of the optimal distance AND 0.8 km. The governing trace figure (EV-GPS-02816, not the rounded 20.6 km convenience copy on the trip record) is 20.58 km against a booked optimal of 19.60 km (EV-TRIP-02816) — an excess of 0.98 km, or 5.00%. The percentage limb fails, so no deviation is established, POL-RD-02 does not run, and the distance charge of SGD 14.70 and the time charge of SGD 7.42 stand.

THE ERP LINE: REFUNDED IN FULL. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02816) carries one ERP line — AYE Alexandra Rd gantry, SGD 3.00, at lat 1.289647, lng 103.863838. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating a fix within 250 m of it as a crossing; the nearest of the trace's 162 fixes is 330.73 m away (at 11:10:50), outside that radius. The trace is complete — 100.0% coverage, a steady 10-second interval, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s — so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c). On the measurement the policy prescribes, that gantry was not crossed. POL-RD-09(4) makes a charge for a gantry the trace never passes a billing-integrity failure, refunded in full as a standalone correction available whether or not a deviation exists. Amount returned: SGD 3.00. The SGD 0.50 de minimis floor governs POL-RD-02 recomputations and does not trim this correction, and the correction is not netted against distance or time. The disputed amount on file is SGD 5.00, but the claim as pleaded is the SGD 3.00 ERP line and that is what is returned; base fare SGD 3.80, distance SGD 14.70, time SGD 7.42 and platform fee SGD 0.80 all reconcile to the trip record and are properly chargeable. Total charged was SGD 30.55.

ARGUMENTS THAT DID NOT SUCCEED. (1) The driver's submission that a 330.73 m closest approach does not prove the path never entered the 250 m circle is rejected: the 250 m radius is the match rule POL-RD-09 itself states, the trace is dense and gap-free, and the gantry carries coordinates, so the 'undecidable, treat as matched' rule for coordinate-less gantries does not apply. (2) The driver's alternative submission succeeds and is reflected in the remedy: the correction is confined to the single line, SGD 3.00, and is a pass-through of a government-set charge rather than a payment by the driver. (3) The driver's statement that 'the ERP is charged by the system' cites no artifact and no clause; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that points to nothing carries no weight, and that a machine raised the line does not answer POL-RD-09(4), which tests the line against the trace.

PROFILES. No profile field decides anything here. POL-GEN-01 makes rating, acceptance rate, account age, lifetime trips, cancellation rate and the lifetime prior_* counters context only, and they were not used. The citable counters were checked and neither test engages: driver deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 395 completed trips in 90 days, so POL-RD-06 finds no pattern and no conduct referral follows; rider deviation_claims_60d is 1 with 0 substantiated, so POL-RD-08's reliability factor does not bite.

MISSING ADVISORY. EV-ADVIS-02816-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and carries no fact. No party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 was unavailable on the record and no closure-adjusted optimal exists; this is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction, and it does not escalate the case.

ESCALATION AND EXECUTION. No escalation applies. POL-RD-10(8) is expressly not triggered where the only unmatched fare line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), the POL-RD-09(4) referral is an addition to this ruling and not an escalation, and nothing in POL-RD-10(1)–(7) fires. Every artifact the ruling rests on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02(2) discount caps confidence and the 0.70 floor is not approached. The monetary effect, SGD 3.00, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 and is executed automatically on issue. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the disputed charge is SGD 20.64 and the amount contested is SGD 3.00. This is a rider-filed ROUTE_DEVIATION dispute and the outcome is NO_ACTION — the charge stands and no money moves to either side.

DISTANCE AND DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is the GPS trace. EV-GPS-02827 records trace_distance_km 14.4 against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on EV-TRIP-02827 — an excess of 5.4 km, which is 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the excess also clears the 50% materiality gate, so a MATERIAL route deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The trace itself is clean for policy purposes — 114 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, 100% coverage — so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not met, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. Both advocates' agreement on this point is accepted.

NO ADJUSTMENT TO THE EXCESS. The chat log EV-CHAT-02827 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and POL-RD-04 is unavailable; the trip record shows null amendment timestamps and a null amended optimal, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', names no advisory evidence ID, and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the case does not escalate on that ground. I have weighed the driver's traffic excuse and rejected it as unsupported on this record; the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km / 60.0%.

THE FARE ARITHMETIC. On the METERED model (quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply), POL-RD-02 computes recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02827, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 14.99. Charged_total is 20.66, giving a POL-RD-02 refund of 5.67, rounded UP to 5.70. Both advocates agree on this figure and it is correct; I record it as the base figure.

THE REMEDY UPLIFT (POL-RD-06). The driver profile EV-DPROF-02827 shows deviation_flags_90d of 3 and completed_trips_90d of 180. The clause establishes a pattern when deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more OR the ratio is 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips. Three flags meets the first limb outright, so a repeat pattern is ESTABLISHED. I reject the driver advocate's argument that the 0.0167 ratio defeats the test: the clause's two limbs are alternatives, not cumulative, and the 'permissive' reading of limb (b) is not what the clause says — the three effects listed are what follow once the pattern is established. Because the deviation here is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) upgrades the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial to FULL_REFUND of charged_total. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge line exists to be settled separately under POL-RD-09 (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, erp_gantries empty), so the whole charged_total is uplifted. Side by side: the POL-RD-02 figure is 5.70; the uplifted POL-RD-06(b) figure is 20.66. The uplift is a remedy uplift only — the finding of deviation rests on this trip's trace alone, not on the driver's history, and POL-GEN-01 is respected: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d were used, and prior_deviation_flags (5) is a lifetime counter that grounded nothing.

EV-FARE-02827 itemises no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no fixed surcharges, and its lines reconcile to the 20.66 charged, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and no billing-integrity correction or referral arises. EV-RPROF-02827 shows deviation_claims_60d 0, so POL-RD-08's serial-claimant corroboration enhancement is not in play.

Under POL-RD-06(c) the case is additionally referred to driver-conduct review; that referral rides with the money and does not displace or delay it. Confidence is 0.90 — the cap is the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts, and EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827 and EV-DPROF-02827 are each at weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 20.66 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is issued but not executed automatically: the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

To the rider and the driver: the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70 to the rider.

What the evidence shows. The governing distance figure is the trace, not the rounded copy carried on the trip record. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: max_gap_sec is 0.0, there is no jump over 500 m and no sampling interval over 30 seconds, so the deviation can be found on the trace alone.

The driver's explanation. The driver's statement that there were 'road works' is not supported by anything. The only traffic advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-02828-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) with no payload at all. The driver-profile check. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, POL-RD-06 requires the check and it is run. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2, below the threshold of 3, and 2 over 180 completed trips in 90 days is 0.011, below 0.05. No repeat pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (4) is a different, context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

The refund. The fare (EV-FARE-02828) is METERED. Refund = charged_total 20.66 less 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 27.4% of the charge, well below the 90% that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund. The fare carries zero ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top. On the driver's separate compensation limb, the distance billed (14.4 km) equals the distance traced, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall and no compensation is due.

The driver argued the refund should be capped at the SGD 4.00 shown in the dispute record. I do not accept that. No clause caps a refund at the contested figure: POL-RD-02 keys the refund to charged_total and the recomputed fare, and states its full-refund test as a share of charged_total. The SGD 4.00 is not an operative ceiling.

Confidence is 0.90; every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02828, EV-TRIP-02828, EV-FARE-02828) is at weight 1.0, and the missing advisory carries nothing. The monetary effect, SGD 5.70, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it.

What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the record shows a real but small route deviation, and the fare charged on this trip is SGD 1.05 more than the policy allows. That amount is refunded to the rider; the rest of the charge stands and no separate payment is due to the driver.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The GPS trace for TRP-02844 (EV-GPS-02844, weight 1.0) records 4.04 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off, against a platform optimal of 3.20 km (EV-TRIP-02844, weight 1.0). The excess is 0.84 km, or 26.25% of the optimal. POL-RD-01 requires both establishment tests and both pass (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. I used the trace figure because POL-RD-01 makes it govern: the trip record's rounded 4.00 km would give exactly 0.80 km and fail the strict absolute gate, and the clause forbids citing it for this test. The excess is below both materiality gates (50%, 8.0 km), so the deviation is ordinary, not material: POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral follow. I ran the profile check anyway, as the clause directs where the evidence is finely balanced: 1 deviation flag over 247 completed trips in 90 days is a ratio of about 0.004 against the 0.05 test, and 1 flag against the 3-flag test, so no repeat pattern is established on either limb. No profile field was used as a fact about this trip (POL-GEN-01).

THE TRACE IS CLEAN. 46 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m and no sampling interval over 30 seconds, so the trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The deviation may rest on the trace alone and no independent corroboration is needed under POL-RD-07(ii).

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's account ('One-way streets') asserts an outside traffic cause, and POL-RD-13 tests such an assertion against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. There is no advisory on file: EV-ADVIS-02844-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the 0.84 km excess nor supplies an adjusted optimal route. The assertion is discarded and I record that no advisory was on file.

WHY THIS IS NOT ESCALATED. The driver asks for escalation under POL-RD-10(5) and POL-RD-13(1). I do not escalate. POL-RD-13(1) applies only where the asserting party names an evidence ID for an advisory; the driver's own account names none, and an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one. The briefs' references to the minted advisory identifier describe the gap in the bundle rather than a record the driver pointed to as its evidence; the absence of an artifact cited as nothing more than an absence is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. POL-RD-10(5) is therefore not engaged, no other mandatory trigger in POL-RD-10 (1)-(8) fires, and the case is decided on the record. For both parties' information: the missing advisory is the only record that could have changed this outcome, by exonerating the route under POL-RD-03 had it existed.

NO OTHER EXONERATION. No rider-requested detour: the chat log EV-CHAT-02844 is complete and holds 0 messages, so there is no instruction and no waypoint_hint to test (POL-RD-04 unavailable). No endpoint change: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no substitute figure may be derived. No pooling: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and the baseline remains the booked optimal of 3.20 km.

THE REFUND. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 (not POL-RD-11) governs and the arithmetic is not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.20 km + 0.28 x 6.0 min) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 8.68. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02844, the only artifact that carries that field. charged_total = 9.70. Refund = 9.70 - 8.68 = 1.02, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 1.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and about 10.5% of the charged total, far below the 90% share that would convert this to a full refund, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 1.05.

NO ADDITIONAL PASS-THROUGH OR BILLING CORRECTION. erp_gantries is empty, tolls and airport surcharge are 0.00, the waiting-time fee is 0.00 and the promo discount is 0.00, so there is no unmatched or phantom line for POL-RD-09(4) to refund and no off-route ERP to itemise; and under POL-RD-09(1) any such ERP would already be comprehended in the figure above and could never be stacked on it. No billing-integrity referral arises.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. The driver was billed for 4.00 km against a 4.04 km trace, a shortfall of 0.04 km, far below the 1.0 km that POL-RD-04's compensation limb requires, so driver_compensation_sgd is null.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. The evidence carrying this ruling - GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown - is all at weight 1.0, so confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect (SGD 1.05) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue under POL-GEN-05. This ruling was made without human review and is provisional; either party may ask for a human decision, or appeal it under POL-GEN-04, within 30 days.

This ruling concerns trip TRP-02847 (28 Aug 2026, Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 to Blk 1 Holland Close) under POLICY-ROUTE-DEVIATION. It is addressed to both parties.

DEVIATION ESTABLISHED (POL-RD-01). The booked optimal route is 2.4 km; the GPS polyline measures 67.2 km. Excess = 64.8 km, or 2,700% of optimal. Both establishment gates (>0.8 km, >20%) and both materiality gates (>8.0 km, >50%) are cleared by orders of magnitude. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure; here it agrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km, so the trace-governs proviso raises no divergence.

TRACE NOT IMPAIRED. EV-GPS-02847 carries 611 fixes at a 10-second sample interval against an expected 10 seconds, coverage_pct 100.0, gaps empty and max_gap_sec 0.0. None of POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is met, so no independent corroboration is required, no stretch is measured as a bounding straight line, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

THE DRIVER'S ACCOUNT. 'The rider changed the destination verbally' is unsupported anywhere in the pool. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped within the clause's window, specific enough to act on, and corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint. EV-CHAT-02847 contains zero messages: there is no instruction, no waypoint_hint, and the 200 m test cannot be run. POL-RD-04 is therefore unavailable and, on the clause's own terms, the case is decided on the remaining clauses. The trip record corroborates the absence of any change of mind: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km, original_pickup and original_dropoff are all null, so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote and no distance is excluded. The statement also cites no evidence ID, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight.

ESCALATION CONSIDERED AND REJECTED. I have not treated the driver's account as a POL-RD-10(5) trigger. Nothing in this bundle is an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact that is missing, out of window or field-deficient: the driver cites no artifact at all, and an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one (the principle POL-RD-13(1) states for uncited excuses). POL-RD-04's own text directs that where the corroboration test cannot be run the case is decided on the remaining clauses, not held. Equally, no traffic advisory supports any external cause: EV-ADVIS-02847-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and any traffic excuse would carry no weight — none was in fact asserted. Finally, trip identifiers and timestamps agree across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02847; first fix and started_at both 08:22:29; last fix and ended_at both 10:04:09), and no artifact's timestamps run backwards.

FARE RECOMPUTATION (POL-RD-02; fare_model METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + 0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge multiplier, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 7.80. charged_total = 83.48; refund = 83.48 - 7.80 = 75.68, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 75.70. That is 90.66% of charged_total, at or above the 90% threshold, so POL-RD-02 directs FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND as the return of the whole contested amount. The amount returned to the rider is therefore the full SGD 83.48.

THE DRIVER'S ALTERNATIVE FIGURE. The arithmetic of 75.68 and the round-up to 75.70 are correct and I accept them, but the submission that only 75.70 may be returned is rejected: once the computed refund reaches 90% of charged_total the clause converts the outcome to FULL_REFUND, and the base fare, platform fee and time charge are not separately retained. The rider's submission on this point is accepted.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION (POL-RD-04). The compensation limb requires the fare breakdown to bill less distance than the trace records, by more than 1.0 km. distance_charged_km is 67.2 and trace_distance_km is 67.2, so the shortfall is nil and no payment to the driver arises.

NO REPEAT-DEVIATION PATTERN (POL-RD-06). driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 210 — neither the 3-flag limb nor the 0.05-ratio limb is met, so no pattern is established. No POL-RD-06(b) uplift applies (and none is needed, the arithmetic already yielding FULL_REFUND) and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field, is context only under POL-GEN-01, and grounds no finding. The rider's citable counters (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0) are far below the POL-RD-08 corroboration condition, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required.

NO BILLING-INTEGRITY REFERRAL (POL-RD-09(4)). There are no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge and no promo discount; the distance charge matches the trace and no charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or trip record. Nothing is refunded on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, which already comprehends the whole of the charge.

EXECUTION (POL-GEN-05). The monetary effect of SGD 83.48 exceeds the execution_threshold_sgd of SGD 8.00, so this ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held in the human queue for confirmation of release. That is a procedural step and does not alter the ruling.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-02847, EV-TRIP-02847 and EV-FARE-02847 — is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02(2) cap reduces confidence. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) is not engaged.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip record EV-TRIP-02850 puts the booked optimal distance at 14.0 km. The admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-GPS-02850 IMPAIRED on issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.60, and both advocates disclosed that discount.

The fact that the vehicle drove 18.2 km is carried by the impaired trace alone. trip_record.actual_distance_km is, in POL-RD-01's own words, a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be used for the threshold test; and the fare ledger's 18.2 km (EV-FARE-02850) is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) states is not independent corroboration. No second, independent artifact carries that distance, so the cap is 0.60, not 1.00. The rider's argument that the clean 14.0 km optimal (EV-TRIP-02850, weight 1.0) lifts the cap to 1.00 is rejected: the excess needs the driven distance as well as the optimal, and only the impaired trace supplies the driven distance. A cap of 0.60 is below the platform's 0.70 confidence floor, so POL-RD-10(1) applies and the outcome is ESCALATE.

This is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02856 (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 130 Bukit Batok West Ave 6). Both sides largely agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides it.

A deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 23.79 km), not the rounded trip-record copy of 23.8 km. Against the booked optimal of 18.3 km on EV-TRIP-02856, the excess is 5.49 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both establishment gates pass (over 0.8 km absolute and over 20%). The profile counters confirm this independently: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 408 completed trips in 90 days, far below the 3-flag and 0.05-rate tests.

The driver's explanation (counterparty statement: 'The rider asked for IMM, it is in the chat', and the chat itself) does not reduce the excess. The rider's message MSG-02856-001 at 15:33:19 does name IMM with a platform-resolved waypoint_hint, and the driver replied 'ok', but POL-RD-04 corroboration is geographic: the trace must pass within 200 m of the waypoint. The derived waypoint approach places the nearest fix 3,088.34 m from IMM (within_threshold false), so the corroboration test fails. Under POL-RD-14 that means the instruction did not cause the measured excess: POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and the deviation is measured on the trace as it stands. The driver's bare assertion of the request is an assertion that fails on the artifact it rests on. This is also not the mutually contradictory-evidence escalation in POL-RD-10(7): a request made and a route that did not follow it are consistent, and POL-RD-14 confines that trigger to the partly-corroborated case. There is no escalation on this point.

No other exoneration route is open. POL-RD-03 (road closure) needs a traffic advisory: none covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02856-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no payload) and no party asserted a traffic cause, so no traffic excuse is even in play. POL-RD-05 does not run: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null, so the baseline stays the booked 18.3 km. POL-RD-12 does not run: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not run: the fare model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE.

The refund is therefore the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on a METERED fare. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, where it is 1.0, not assumed absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 24.441 + 0.80 = 25.241. Refund = charged_total 31.13 - 25.241 = 5.889, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 18.9% of the charged total, far below the 90% that would convert it to a FULL_REFUND. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.90, not the SGD 8.00 contested and not the SGD 31.13 charged.

Nothing is added under POL-RD-09. The fare carries no ERP lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), no airport surcharge (0.00, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no waiting-time fee. There is no unmatched gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, so no billing-integrity finding and no referral arises. Driver compensation under POL-RD-04 does not arise either: the rider was billed 23.8 km against a 23.79 km trace, a shortfall of well under the 1.0 km threshold.

The trace is clean for POL-RD-07 purposes: 187 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so no limb (a) to (c) is met and no corroboration requirement or POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02856), timestamps do not conflict, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires. My confidence rests on artifacts all at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02856, EV-TRIP-02856, EV-FARE-02856, EV-CHAT-02856), so the cap is 1.0; the missing advisory (weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact and does not lower it. The one rider claim citing that absent artifact was discarded at the citation stage for not naming its issue code. My confidence of 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate.

The monetary effect of SGD 5.90 is at or below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling may be executed on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

THE ARITHMETIC. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02859, weight 1.0). Under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = ((SGD 3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 22.0 km + 0.28 x 30.0 min) x the 2.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + SGD 0.80 platform fee = (SGD 28.70 x 2.0) + SGD 0.80 = SGD 58.20. Charged_total is SGD 224.12, so the refund would be SGD 224.12 - SGD 58.20 = SGD 165.92, i.e. SGD 165.95 rounded up. That is 74.03% of charged_total, below the 90% that would make it a full refund, so the rider's recovery on the merits would be a partial refund only. The fare carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines (0.00, no gantries, trip originates at Jurong Point), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is counted twice.

WHY NO MONETARY RULING ISSUES. The refund computed under POL-RD-02, SGD 165.92, exceeds the SGD 150.00 ceiling in POL-RD-10(6). That is a mandatory escalation trigger, and it is the trigger that fired here. Escalation under POL-RD-10 is terminal and replaces the ruling under POL-GEN-03: no refund and no compensation issue, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. The rider's own fallback position on this is correct, and the driver's primary position on it is also correct; the two sides simply arrive at the same place from opposite directions.
